name: 原始 TLS/Rust 客户端有界浮动定时轮换
summary: 单一 Linux 原始 Go 路径 supervisor 上可配置定时轮换±jitter；Game2/4整组真实认证代际替换而非逐 lane 独立热换，记录每一 lane 的全组新五元组和 native M4 身份。

usage.cli: Linux client --rotation-interval 18s --rotation-jitter 3s; jitter must be <= interval/3, min armed delay >=5s; server rejects positive interval
usage.config: Original Go CLI client cold supervisor only; no on-wire field

verification.scope: Seven independent real 3-device 443 TLS/Rust M4 scenes, 4 timed jittered group generations; Game4 each of four original authenticated lane tuples checked. Native action pending.

limitations: Game4 one native GameAdapter and shared FEC/first-delivery owner uses complete-cohort replacement; independent lane-at-a-time rotating without restarting 3 siblings NOT_IMPLEMENTED and NOT_RUN.
No zero-loss promise on actual WAN: test has no physical impairment; high-loss/Windows/Android not qualified.
H998 hot same-socket MTU FAIL and historical ARM Game4 FAIL retained. H1225 ARM p99 prior source does not certify H1226 source.
